summary: netapp_eseries.santricity renamed the raid_level volume option to ddp_raid_level for dynamic disk pool volumes.
questions: What is raid_level called now in na_santricity_volume?

answer_card.title: santricity raid_level renamed
answer_card.answer_md: In `na_santricity_volume` and `nar_santricity_host`, the volume option `raid_level` is renamed **`ddp_raid_level`** for dynamic disk pool volumes.
